Container.Name: hallway-dash
Container.Overview: Self-hosted, always-on wall-display dashboard for a hallway/kitchen TV (portrait orientation). Shows clock, date, current weather + 6-day forecast, sunrise/sunset, indoor temp/humidity (via Home Assistant), a rolling 4-week calendar (personal events + waste/bin-collection days), a NINA/BBK civil-protection alert banner, a rotating monthly background photo, and a random joke. Every third-party API call (Open-Meteo, ICS feeds, NINA, Home Assistant, joke source) happens server-side, so no browser CORS issues and your Home Assistant token never reaches the display. Every data source degrades gracefully if unset or unreachable - nothing is required to get it running. See https://github.com/mbirnbach/hallway-dash for full setup docs.
Container.Description: Self-hosted, always-on wall-display dashboard for a hallway/kitchen TV. Clock, weather, rolling 4-week calendar (personal + waste/bin collection), civil-protection alerts, monthly background photo, and a joke - all rendered fullscreen for a browser kiosk. Point a browser/kiosk device at http://[IP]:[PORT:8080]/ once running.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is served on

Config.Name: Backgrounds Folder
Config.Description: Folder containing 01.jpg ... 12.jpg monthly background photos. Missing months fall back to a placeholder automatically.

Config.Name: Location Label
Config.Description: Display name shown next to the current weather

Config.Name: Personal Calendar ICS URL
Config.Description: ICS feed URL for your personal calendar (leave blank to hide)

Config.Name: Waste/Bin Calendar ICS URL
Config.Description: ICS feed URL for waste/bin-collection days (leave blank to hide, renders as amber pills)

Config.Name: AGS Code
Config.Description: 12-digit Amtlicher Gemeindeschluessel for NINA/BBK civil-protection alerts (leave blank to disable)

Config.Name: Joke API URL
Config.Description: Joke source (plain-text response expected); falls back to JokeAPI.dev automatically if unreachable

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Home Assistant instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123 (leave blank to hide indoor stat)

Config.Name: Home Assistant Temperature Entity
Config.Description: Entity ID of your indoor temperature sensor

Config.Name: Home Assistant Humidity Entity
Config.Description: Entity ID of your indoor humidity sensor

Config.Name: Accent Color
Config.Description: Hex accent color used for bin-day pills, today's date circle, and the "Heute" label
